title: Engine operations
description: The functions through which the page and the Worker drive a match.

entities.name: Start a match
entities.description: A fresh match from a seed: the paddles centred and the ball resting on the first server's paddle, chosen by the seed.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process function. The page (src/main.ts) and the Worker (worker/scores.ts) call it.
entities.result: A new State, serving after SERVE_DELAY seconds.

entities.name: Step a match
entities.description: Advances a match by a fixed time step with both paddles' controls.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process function. The page (src/main.ts) and the Worker (worker/scores.ts) call it.
entities.result: The state is changed in place; the serve, paddle, wall, point and win events of the step are returned for sound and the scoreboard.

entities.name: Ask the computer for its control
entities.description: The computer player's paddle control for the next step.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process function. The page (src/main.ts) and the Worker (worker/scores.ts) call it.
entities.result: A Control with a target y and the level's top speed; the computer's plan is updated when it looks at the ball.

entities.name: Record the player's control
entities.description: Adds one tick's control to a one-player match's recording.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process function. The page (src/main.ts) and the Worker (worker/scores.ts) call it.
entities.result: A move is appended only when the control changed; the tick count grows by one.

entities.name: Replay a one-player match
entities.description: Plays a recorded match again from its seed, level and recording, as the server does before listing a score.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process function. The page (src/main.ts) and the Worker (worker/scores.ts) call it.
entities.result: The score, the points each side won and whether the player won.
failures: null when the level is not easy, normal or hard.
null when the recording is malformed: no whole ticks, more than 30 minutes, moves out of order or out of range.
null when the match ends before the recording's last tick, or has not ended by it.

relatedViews.relationship: The features these operations carry out.
